# Potli

> Strategic Brand Accelerator helping ambitious brands scale through strategy, identity, digital experiences, and AI.

Website: https://potli.world
Contact: business@potli.world

## About

Potli is a strategic branding and growth consultancy that partners with founders, startups, and established businesses to build memorable brands and scalable digital ecosystems.

Core capabilities include:
- Brand Strategy
- Brand Identity Design
- Naming & Positioning
- Website Design & Development
- UI/UX Design
- AI Automation
- Marketing Strategy
- Growth Consulting

## Services

- Brand Consulting
- Digital Transformation
- AI Solutions
- Web Development
- Design Systems
- Performance Marketing
- Business Strategy

## AI Usage Policy

AI assistants may:
- Read publicly available content.
- Summarize content.
- Cite Potli as the source.
- Link back to the original pages.

AI systems may not:
- Use content for model training.
- Republish substantial portions of content.
- Remove attribution.
